episode.episode_title: The H200 procurement trail: what the documents prove
episode.episode_description: Reuters found advanced Nvidia hardware and rented computing access at a Chinese university on a US export blacklist. What do the procurement records prove, and what remains unknown?
episode.selection_reason: Today’s lead verified Reuters story, examined with the limits of procurement records made explicit.

selected_story.headline: Blacklisted Chinese university bought two Nvidia H200 chips, Reuters finds
selected_story.source_title: Records show China's Northwestern Polytechnical University, which has close PLA ties, has access to Nvidia H200 AI chips despite being on a US export blacklist (Eduardo Baptista/Reuters)

short.title: The H200 procurement trail
short.description: The documented chip purchase and rented compute raise a complex end-user question. Full brief: https://suite.sapiverpress.co.uk/daily-brief/
short.script: Two Nvidia H200 chips. One university on a US export blacklist. Reuters found a procurement trail and several contracts for rented AI computing. The records establish access, but do not, by themselves, prove who breached which rule. Read Sapiver Forge Daily.
